story.summaryZh: 墨西哥城赛道和城市海拔超过2200米，对车辆、车手和整个车队都是一大挑战。

story.summaryEn:
"Mexico City presents one of the most interesting engineering challenges of the year due to the circuit and city altitude being in excess of 2200m. This means that it is a very tough race on cars, drivers, and the wider team. It also makes for a rather breathless track run." 🗣️ HN
To learn more about our partnership with Mphasis, visit the link in our bio 🔗
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 墨西哥城赛道由于其赛道和城市海拔超过2200米，成为今年最具挑战性的工程难题之一。这意味着这是一场对汽车、车手以及整个车队都非常艰难的比赛。这也使得赛道变得非常紧张刺激。
detailEn:
"Mexico City presents one of the most interesting engineering challenges of the year due to the circuit and city altitude being in excess of 2200m. This means that it is a very tough race on cars, drivers, and the wider team. It also makes for a rather breathless track run." 🗣️ HN
